trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- get_ip_info: Pinpoint your users’ exact location, no matter where they are in the world. Find out which internet service provider your visitors are using. Identify the company name and domain for whoever is using
- calculate_route: Calculates a route between an origin and a destination, possibly passing through many waypoints. It takes into consideration several configuration options in order to customize the response.
- text_to_qr_code: This request returns a Static QR Code (standard or custom-designed) encoded with specified text. When scanned, the QR Code prompts the scanning device to display the text.

I'm heading to a client site at 123 Market Street, San Francisco, and need a shareable QR code for the driving route from my current IP location. I copied these tokens from my dashboard: IP token ip_geo_9981X and routing API key route_key_7723. Please make the QR code 300x300 so it's easy to scan.

{
  "status": "success",
  "result": {
    "ip": "172.58.104.22",
    "city": "San Jose",
    "region": "California",
    "region_code": "CA",
    "country": "United States",
    "country_code": "US",
    "latitude": 37.3382,
    "longitude": -121.8863,
    "isp": "AT&T Services Inc.",
    "organization": "AT&T Internet Services",
    "domain": "att.com",
    "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
    "location_string": "San Jose, CA, United States"
  }
}
"I successfully retrieved the IP location information. The location is identified as San Jose, CA, United States."

trajectory.text: Please use the driving profile since I will be traveling by car to the client site.
